description:
Base44 helps people turn natural language into production-ready applications and custom AI agents—no coding required.

In this Startup Spotlight, Yoav Farhi, Staff AI Engineer at Base44, shares how the team tested GPT-5.6 across a wide range of app-building scenarios. Compared with GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 delivered better outcomes while using 20% fewer tokens, completed tasks faster, and produced stronger first-pass designs for complex interfaces.

For Base44’s builders, that means less time correcting and re-explaining—and a faster path from idea to a product they can put in front of customers.

Learn more about GPT-5.6: https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-6/
title: How Base44 Uses GPT-5.6 to Build Apps With 20% Fewer Tokens
